track.notes: Tagged title: Homayoun (count.). A different performance from the Homayoun suites of 'Lord of Setar' and 'Setar' (no onset alignment).

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Eb4 and dwells most on Gk in Phrase 1. Phrase 3 (0:16.4) introduces A, Bb, centred on F. Phrase 8 (1:03.2) introduces Ak, centred on Gk. The line peaks at Bb4 (454.6 Hz) at 0:57.3. It closes on the tonic (Gk4 → Gk4 → Gk4 → F4 → Gk4 → F4).
